race.comment: ONLY US (2) has grown a leg since coming to Carnarvon, holding on to score by a nostril over the mile here last time out as favourite. The form out of that race has been solid and he continues to raise the bar. Out in trip again now and can extend the winning run. AWESOME LILY (7) led them up last start over the mile and was too good as a $13 chance when on the quick turnaround. She's placed 2/3 at this track and trip previously and if she gets a touch of luck from the barrier, she'll be in this for a very long way. DREAM ILLUSION (4) did well to score at this track two runs ago. Decent effort last time out when fourth over 1400m at this track, beaten 2 lengths. Has his share of talent. Hard to beat in this suitable race. ODIN OMEN (11) knuckled down strongly to get within 1.3 lengths of the winner in third last start over 1600m at this track. Among the main hopes. DAIYAMONDO (3) was too good last start and has to be included.
